newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed stronger at 3.16 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed stronger at 3.16 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1075 to the dollar, down from 3.0980 on Monday and at 1.8120 to the mark, up from 1.8190, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 3.16 percent from the weighted dollar and mark NBP parity rates, stronger than Monday's 3.05 percent fix.
According to the floating parity rate, which changes in line with currency moves on world markets, the zloty was fixed at 3.18 percent from parity against Monday's 3.12 percent fix.
